items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: the Godfather went up in some malls for Peter's wife, you see. And we went up into Westchester in different places like that

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, the Godfather of the quotations, you see. But I'm in the throes of discovery, see, because I have a great hope for someone that I think is going to be another early master, see, like the scratch rock was to the Injuns. I guess you'd -- (Recording interruption)

Chuck, there's one question that has always puzzled me, and I think it's a pertinent closing question before you do a last dance. With the whole history of tap dancing, the struggle through tap dancing, the ups and downs of a tap dancer, the ups and downs of show business and public appeal, why do you stick with it? What was that driving force in you that kept you dancing?
